Hi Kim / Ben —

Quick update from our side: we’ve had a last-minute reprioritization in our roadmap. Our VP of Product pulled the data-modeling sprint forward and they’re reassigning most of the ML/inference headcount to the data foundation work through Q3 — effectively pausing any new inference pilot work for the near term.

Given that, we’d like to pause the demo cadence we had planned and put this conversation on a soft hold. We still believe Redwood looks promising, but timing is the problem right now. Can we do the following?

- Pause the active demo/workshop until early Q4 (we’ll have a better sense of bandwidth by then)
- Keep a short one-pager of the demo agenda and security notes on file
- Revisit in mid-December to set a tentative window for January

I’m copying Priya from Product so she’s in the loop. Apologies for the churn — happy to talk through if it helps.

Thanks,
Devon Hart
Head of Data Platform
Turnstile Analytics

Devon —

Totally understand and thanks for the heads up. Ok to pause — appreciate the transparency. A few quick items to keep this productive while you re-prioritize: 

- I’ll drop the full demo agenda and the short security FAQ into our thread (attached) so your Product/Security folks have something to review asynchronously. No pressure to schedule until you confirm capacity.
- If helpful, we can convert the upcoming live workshop into a 30-minute technical office hours session for your infra team (lighter lift, less scheduling overhead).
- Proposed next step: we’ll set a tentative check-in in mid-December (Dec 15) to confirm whether Jan is realistic. If you prefer another date, tell me and I’ll send a hold.

Would you like me to leave the original calendar hold in place (we can remove it now and send a tentative hold for Dec 15), or should I change it to a tentative Jan window?

I’ll also mark the opportunity as "nurture" in our CRM and set a monthly check-in. Ben — can you please prepare a one-pager on lightweight infra pre-reqs we can share with Priya?

Thanks,
Kim
